minecraft:written_book_content.title: Household Ledger
minecraft:written_book_content.author: E. Rowan
pages: {"text":"The harvest was stored and the doors were barred from the outside."}
{"text":"Every family left a place setting for someone who had not yet arrived."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The outpost roster names a settlement that does not appear on any surviving map. Its evacuation date is earlier than the first barricade order."}
